name: @quest-city-web/platform-admin
description: School Pilot Readiness Tranche A: Platform Admin identity, capability-first authorization, School tenant provisioning and status enforcement (Idempotency-Key required, 02_26 v1.10 §32.4), and first School Admin activation (02_38 v1.0/v1.1 §4.1/§5.2/§5.3/§9/§20-21). PlatformIdentity reuses @quest-city-web/staff-identity's staff_account exactly (02_38 §20) -- this package never introduces a second identity table. Reuses (never duplicates) tenant read/write and audit repositories from @quest-city-web/identity, and the idempotency mechanism from @quest-city-web/attempts.
